ayahs.1: Kya tujhe bhi chhupa lene wali (qayamat) ki khabar pahunchi hai.
ayahs.2: Us din bahut se chehre zaleel honge.
ayahs.3: (Aur) mehnat karne wale thake hue honge.
ayahs.4: Woh dahakti hui aag mein jaaenge.
ayahs.5: Aur nihaayat garam chashme ka paani un ko pilaya jaayega.
ayahs.6: Un ke liye siwaaye kaante-daar darakhton ke aur kuch khaane ko na hoga.
ayahs.7: Jo na mota karega na bhookh mitaayega.
ayahs.8: Bahut se chehre us din taro-taaza aur (aasooda-haal) honge.
ayahs.11: Jahaan koi be-hooda baat nahi sunenge.
ayahs.13: (Aur) is mein oonche oonche takht honge.
ayahs.15: Aur ek qataar mein lage hue takiye honge.
ayahs.16: Aur makhmali masnaden phaili padi hongi.
ayahs.17: Kya yeh onton ko nahi dekhte ke woh kis tarah paida kiye gaye hain.
ayahs.18: Aur aasmaan ko ke kis tarah ooncha kiya gaya hai.
ayahs.19: Aur pahaadon ki taraf ke kis tarah gaad diye gaye hain.
ayahs.20: Aur zameen ki taraf ke kis tarah bichhaai gayi hai.
ayahs.21: Pas aap naseehat kar diya karen (kyunke) aap sirf naseehat karne wale hain.
ayahs.22: Aap kuch un par daroga nahi hain.
ayahs.23: Haan! Jo shakhs rugardaani kare aur kufr kare.
ayahs.24: Use Allah Taala bahut bada azaab dega.
ayahs.25: Beshak hamari taraf un ka lautna hai.
ayahs.26: Phir beshak hamare zimme hai un se hisaab lena.
